header.running_head: The Noble Character of the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: Hadhrat Ali (RA) narrates, "Ja'far (RA), Zaid (RA) and I once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ said to Zaid (RA), 'You are our brother and friend.' Zaid (RA) skipped with joy. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said to Ja'far (RA), 'You resemble me both in looks and in personality'. Ja'far (RA) then skipped about even more than Zaid (RA). Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to me, 'You are from me and I from you.' I therefore skipped about more than Zaid (RA) and Ja'far (RA)."[^1]

Hadhrat Usaamah bin Zaid (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said to Hadhrat Ja'far (RA), "Your personality is like mine and your physical appearance also resembles my own. You are therefore from me. And you, O Ali. You are also from me and the father of my grandsons."[^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) the son of Hadhrat Ja'far (RA) said, "I heard from Rasulullaah ﷺ such words that I would not trade even for red camels. I heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'Ja'far most resembles my looks and my personality. As for you, O Abdullaah! From all of Allaah's creation, you most resemble your father (Ja'far (RA))."[^3]
The Excellent Character of Hadhrat Umar (RA)

Hadhrat Bahriyyah reports, "When my uncle Khidaash (RA) saw Rasulullaah ﷺ eating from a particular plate, he asked Rasulullaah ﷺ to give it to him. The plate then remained with us afterwards. Whenever Hadhrat Umar (RA) used to ask for it to be taken out, we would fill it with Zamzam water and give it to him. He would then drink from it and pour it over his head and face. However, it once occurred that a thief did us a grave injustice when he stole the plate along with other possessions of ours. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then came to us one day after the theft and asked us to take the plate out. 'O Ameerul Mu'mineen!' we submitted, 'It was stolen along with some other goods of ours.' Hadhrat Umar (RA) exclaimed, 'A pretty clever thief to steal Rasulullaah ﷺ's plate!' By Allaah! Hadhrat Umar (RA) neither swore the thief nor cursed him."[^4]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that when Hadhrat Uyaynah bin Hisn (bin Hudhayfah) bin Badr (RA) arrived (in Madinah), he stayed with his nephew Hadhrat Hurr bin Qais (RA) who happened to be amongst those that Hadhrat Umar (RA) kept close to him. It was only the learned ones whom Hadhrat Umar (RA) kept in his company and with whom he consulted, regardless of whether they were young or old. Hadhrat Uyaynah (RA) said to his nephew, "Dear nephew! Since you have some status in the eyes of the Ameer, please secure permission for me to see him." When Hadhrat Umar (RA) granted permission, Hadhrat Uyaynah (RA) called out, "Hey son of Khattaab! By Allaah! Neither do you give us much nor do you rule us with justice!" This outburst made Hadhrat Umar (RA) so angry that he was close to assaulting Hadhrat Uyaynah
